items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee only responds 'Yep' to the interviewer's statement about Gandhi being an influence on Martin Luther King; no personal connection or direct interaction is described.

ctx.x: In the ’50s we saw the decolonization, which impacted on what was going on in the ’60s. We saw that Africa was fighting to take off the yoke of colonialism. It had a direct impact on what was – on the politics and the world view among African-American leaders. Who was Martin Luther King’s major influence? Mahatma Gandhi. What did he want? Throw off the yoke of colonialism. Throw off the yoke of oppression. So I think it has to be a global zeitgeist, and I think we’re getting some inklings of it now. That’s my…
